- **Site with the missing morning shift:** Pine Crossing. Pree raised this herself in #central-team on Jun 9: the booking screen there only showed the afternoon shift. That was part of the June store rollout escalation, and nothing I could see links it to Halyard by name. Hollis said he'd check the shift template, but no ticket number for that fix has been posted.

I also pointed out two things that could get mixed up with these. PD-4821 is a different ticket, for importing door labels at the Eastbank store. The Foxglove rollout and its contact, Soren Brevik, belong to Marrow Fieldworks, which is a separate account.

Pree is a member of both channels, so everything here is something she could see herself. The contact and ticket number came from the workspace's saved message history (gbrain). I couldn't find those two messages by reading the channels; they may be thread replies.
